title: Bisikan Angin Malam di Tepi Sungai
theme: Sebuah ibu tunggal menemukan kekuatan dan penerimaan diri dalam kesendirian malam, merefleksikan kenangan keluarga dan menemukan harapan lembut untuk hubungan saat ini.

cover.prompt: A tranquil late evening scene, viewed with a cinematic wide shot. A solitary figure, presented as a gentle silhouette from behind, stands at the boundary of a expansive, verdant field beside a calm river. The gentle sway of the tall grass hints at the cool, serene night air. In the distant background, a small, warmly illuminated house provides a sense of quietude under a vast, soft sky. The composition adheres to the rule of thirds, employing a shallow depth of field to emphasize the figure's connection with the natural surroundings. The overall ambiance is one of peaceful introspection and calm.
cover.style: Cinematic photography, minimalist composition, strong silhouettes, gentle cool lighting, shallow depth of field

meta.plan_summary: A single mother, Ibu Kartini, seeks solace by a lonely river at night, reflecting on past family happiness and grappling with the challenges of raising her teenage son alone. A passing boat triggers bittersweet memories, leading her to find hidden strength, self-acceptance, and a gentle hope for future warmth within her current family dynamics.
meta.target_emotion: Nostalgia, melankoli, harapan, ketenangan, penerimaan diri.
